_comment: Codex/ChatGPT-side account config, sibling of claude-accounts.json (env override: SUBFLEET_CODEX_ACCOUNTS). The account backing the interactive ChatGPT/Codex apps is read live from ~/.codex/auth.json; protected_account is only the fallback when that file is missing or unreadable, matched on email or account_id (accepts an object, a bare string, or a list of either). auto_reset governs `subfleet reset codex --policy`. Copy to codex-accounts.json (gitignored).
